1879-2105-5144-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
1879-2105-5144-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-2105-5144-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Ephemerate from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Ephemerate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

141-2292-3905.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2292-3905.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-728-1879.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

620-2111-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1429-3545-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1368-5295-6321-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-5295-6321-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1651-4772-7318.description:
Activate Coin of Mastery by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens due to Doubling Season.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two tokens, untapping Coin of Mastery.
Repeat.

141-3771-7302.description:
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {2} reduced by Animar.
Repeat from step 3.
141-3771-7302.notes: The mana cost can be reduced by {3} if Animar has two or more +1/+1 counters on it when the combo begins. If Animar has one +1/+1 counter, the cost is reduced by {2}.

2842-5170-5686-6132.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2893-3470-4500-6763.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Retreat to Kazandu trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Retreat to Kazandu trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-4862-5411.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4862-5411.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Omnath and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1719-4639-7014.notablePrerequisites: North Pole Patrol and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
1719-4639-7014.description:
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
North Pole Patrol triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting North Pole Patrol.
Vizier of Tumbling Sands triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Repeat.

132-4222-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that share a creature type.
132-4222-7013.description:
Activate Myr Welder using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.

586-2511-5258-5618-6967.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

843-3392-5200-5313.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 22, reduced by 3 for each {1} available.
843-3392-5200-5313.description:
If you have a life total of 4 or higher, activate Treasonous Ogre by paying 3 life, adding {R}.
Repeat step 1 until you have 3 or fewer life or until you have {7} available.
Activate Lin Sivvi's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for Children of Korlis and putting it onto the battlefield.
Activate Children of Korlis by sacrificing it, causing you to gain life equal to the life you've lost this turn.
Repeat steps 1 and 2 once.
Activate Lin Sivvi's second ability by paying {3}, putting Children of Korlis from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Lin Sivvi.
Repeat from step 3.
843-3392-5200-5313.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

3951-5703-5929-6798.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
3951-5703-5929-6798.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

500-2081-4125.description:
Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing another creature, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Shipwreck Dowser and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Shipwreck Dowser tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Culling the Weak from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2781-6132.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Felidar Guardian.
2034-2781-6132.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

222-413-527-1115.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-413-527-1115.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala enter, Slimefoot and Squee triggers once and Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve both Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

511-817-1270-4050-5902.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

11-3617-5257.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}.
Riku's first ability triggers - choose not to pay.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Time Walk.
Riku's first ability triggers, causing you to pay {U}{R} to copy Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Time Walk, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal created in step 5, copying Time Walk and returning the original Time Walk to your hand.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
11-3617-5257.notes: You may pay an additional {U}{R} to copy the extra turn spell, and only need to do this loop during your second extra turn.

1887-2060-2700-2744-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari enters the battlefield, it and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Arcbound Shikari trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

2724-3987-4050-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
2724-3987-4050-5131.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wormfang Manta, adding {U}.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger when it enters the battlefield due to Torpor Orb.
Repeat each turn.

894-914-2178-4050-5220.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Svella.
Svella does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents control at least eight artifacts and/or enchantments.
894-914-2178-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {R/G}.
Dockside Extortionist dies, triggering Svella and Mortuary.
Resolve the Svella trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Dockside Extortionist on top of your library.
Activate Svella's second ability by paying {6}{R}{G} and tapping it, causing you to reveal the top four cards of your library and cast Dockside Extortionist without paying its mana cost.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{R/G}.
Repeat.

796-2440-2871-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Zombies.
796-2440-2871-4050.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}.
Poppet Stitcher triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
The Zombie enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving target creature +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {R}.
Repeat.

262-922.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Altar Golem.
Altar Golem has a power of at least five.
Altar Golem does not have summoning sickness.
262-922.description:
Activate Altar Golem by tapping it, creating at least five 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate Altar Golem by tapping five Elemental tokens, untapping Altar Golem.
Repeat.
